src: 9x9 grid divided by a solid one-pixel cross into one 2x2 color legend, one opposite 6x6 single-color mask, and two empty side regions
transform: replace the input with the 6x6 mask; split it into four 3x3 quadrants and recolor each mask pixel from the corresponding legend cell while preserving background pixels
symbol_instructions: 2x2 color legend maps its cells in reading order to the four 3x3 mask quadrants
